workflows.trigger: A user or technician needs to open, install, share, download, clone, update, or locally edit the current main Prompt Kit on a browser, phone, tablet, Windows PC, macOS, or Linux machine.
owned_scope: cross-device acquisition validator tests and reports
forbidden_scope: requiring a clone for normal browser or phone use
workflows.failure_policy: Preserve existing checkouts and classify the failed gate by access mode: public browser/phone routing, device install, Windows launcher, editable Git checkout, network/authentication, origin/branch/divergence, required-file, or parity failure. Never substitute a destructive or higher-friction route merely to make progress.
handoff_fields: branch and commit when Git is used

workflows.trigger: Canonical prompts, policies, display ordering, long-list navigation, reference data, builder behavior, generator options, checked-in HTML, or Prompt Kit interaction contracts change.
owned_scope: builders and Prompt Kit behavior sources
workflows.failure_policy: Repair canonical sources or contract drift; for ordering/navigation changes run the strict prompt-kit-order-navigation gate and regenerate the canonical site. Never weaken parity, five-prompt navigation density, chronological default ordering, or interaction requirements merely to turn CI green.

workflows.trigger: Maps, workflow specifications, registries, validators, hooks, skills, reports, acquisition surfaces, or versioned domain contracts are missing, stale, or inconsistent.
workflows.failure_policy: Repair the canonical harness component or registry owner, add a regression test, and distinguish a registered product implementation gap from a harness defect. Do not cross into product code merely to make a harness-only sprint green.

workflows.trigger: A triage engine, workbook contract, schema, fixture, or generated artifact behavior changes.
workflows.failure_policy: Preserve protected inputs, reproduce with sanitized fixtures, repair the focused engine, and distinguish static proof from Excel or operator proof.

workflows.trigger: Work is stacked, divergent, superseded, conflicted, blocked, or ready to integrate across branches or pull requests.
owned_scope: authorized merge execution with expected-head protection
forbidden_scope: merging with unresolved required checks or review findings
reporting a green mergeable merge-authorized PR as a blocker
stopping at PR status when merge is authorized and every gate is satisfied
telling normal consumers to fetch a merged feature branch instead of main
workflows.failure_policy: Classify the exact gate with pr-merge-gate/v1. If open, non-draft, mergeable, required checks are green, review findings are resolved, expected head matches, merge intent exists, and merge authority exists, merge now rather than reporting a blocker. After provider merge success, verify main advanced before routing normal consumers to main or its registered artifact. Only unresolved checks, findings, conflicts/unknown mergeability, head movement, closed-unmerged state, or missing merge authority are blockers.

workflows.trigger: Prompt language changes or lazy, placeholder, observation-only, status-only, or non-executable next actions are suspected.
workflows.failure_policy: Stop on coverage or identity drift; repair canonical registry or builder ownership before interpreting language findings.

workflows.trigger: A skill lacks executable correctness, routing, regression, performance, cost, or token-efficiency evidence.
forbidden_scope: moving deterministic product behavior into prose
workflows.failure_policy: Reproduce the weakness, repair the smallest owned boundary, and rerun correctness before accepting efficiency changes.

workflows.trigger: An operator presents a detached prompt-kit-browser-proof-* Temp path or requests safe Prompt Kit browser-proof scratch classification/cleanup.
owned_scope: cleanup receipts and retained receipt backups
workflows.failure_policy: Fail closed and preserve the candidate when temp-root, name, marker, age, reparse-point, report-path, or deletion gates fail. Never widen cleanup scope to recover from a failure.

workflows.trigger: Accepted explicit Prompt Kit feedback has an unconsumed actionable signal that should create bounded AFK development work.
owned_scope: bounded invocation of one configured capable worker
forbidden_scope: second scheduler or infinite polling loop
raw written feedback in provider dispatch payloads
replacement of P99, P115, P07, P32, or P105 ownership
workflows.failure_policy: Fail closed on malformed/sensitive/duplicate signals, create an exact BLOCKED_WORKER_UNCONFIGURED work request when no capable worker adapter exists, and route validated candidates to P105/pr-floor rather than merging here.
